morphology_as_written: The range of particle size of both the C-MOF-5 and T-MOF-5 nanocrystals was 100-150 nm, with no defined morphology
notes: Authors' 'C-MOF-5' (cubic phase). 0.45 g Zn(NO3)2·6H2O (1.51 mmol) and 0.083 g H2BDC (0.50 mmol) in 49 mL DMF + 1 mL H2O; metal_conc_mM computed. Heated to 70 C under vigorous stirring, then oven 100 C for 15 h. Contrast with the large cubes of suresh2021 and mulyati2015: this route gives 100-150 nm particles with no facets. CO2 uptake 79.9 wt% at 298 K and 25 bar (co2_adsorption.csv).

additive_amount: 2.3 mL TEA (16.5 mmol) and three drops of aqueous H2O2
morphology_as_written: The range of particle size of both the C-MOF-5 and T-MOF-5 nanocrystals was 100-150 nm, with no defined morphology
notes: Authors' 'T-MOF-5' (tetragonal, ZnO-rich: TGA residue 57 wt% vs 48.5 wt%). 1.19 g Zn(NO3)2·6H2O (4.0 mmol), 0.34 g H2BDC (2.05 mmol) in 40 mL DMF; TEA added dropwise at 70 C with strong agitation for 2 h; then oven 100 C 15 h. metal_conc_mM computed over 40 mL DMF + 2.3 mL TEA. TEA role assigned from its use as a base in the cited procedure (Huang et al. 2003); the authors do not name it. CO2 uptake 67.6 wt% at 298 K and 25 bar.
